What to look for: DXC (dxc_1_6_2112 and dxc_trunk panes) fails both compiles inside
struct S's member functions with

    error: cannot compile this aggregate expression yet

on the `return this;` line and on the `dst = this;` line -- an ordinary diagnosed compile
error (not a crash), reported at both call sites. The FXC pane (fxc_10_0_19041, run at
cs_5_0 since FXC has no cs_6_0 profile) accepts the same struct/member-function shape and
produces ordinary DXBC, with no equivalent diagnostic -- the FXC/DXC disagreement the issue
reports. This does not show the DXIL/SPIR-V split from the issue thread's maintainer comment;
Compiler Explorer's dxc panes only emit DXIL here, matching the repro's own command line.
